scope.profile: Generated C Make public reconstruction profile with a 256 KiB mutation and snapshot ceiling
scope.coverage: At every beginTask dispatch in the focused method, the exact non-recursive declared-role authority is checked for owner, profile digest, target path, declaration ID/roles, UTF8_TEXT, byte ceiling, and create/write-only operation set. Two existing-target cases seed an implementation before dispatch, have the scripted agent write it, then use a host-side after-prompt hook to delete the target or change its POSIX mode before final snapshot capture. The receipt requires WORKSPACE_VIOLATION at final-workspace-snapshot, verified cleanup, and no complete execution evidence; publication metadata and transaction-residue assertions verify refusal preserves the accepted publication.
qualificationLimits: local scripted ACP and host-injected final-state evidence for Generated C Make only
delete and chmod are not advertised agent operations; the injections test final snapshot observation and authorization
